subject: [PATCH v4 06/13] mm/collapse: drop the collapse_possible() wrapper

2026-09-28.patch_summary: This patch removes a wrapper function called collapse_possible() that simply forwards to another function called collapse_possible_orders(). The three callers of collapse_possible() can directly test the mask returned by collapse_possible_orders(), so there is no need for the extra layer. This change has no functional impact and only simplifies the code.
